Post the sign-up link for Sunday
Remind everyone the van leaves at eight
Confirm who has the key to the storeroom

text: Hi all, need someone for sat sorting shift 9-12? We're short 2 people. Who can? 🙏
I can do sat morning. What time do we start
9 at the warehouse, till 12ish
sat morning i got deliveries till like 11 😭 can do 12-2 if that works?
12-2 works!! Would help if someone covers 9-12 too
Can't this weekend, my mother has an appointment. Sorry
No worries! Still need one more for the morning
Also who's bringing the van for sunday? Need to pick up from the supermarket by 8
can ask my dad if he can drive the van sun morning?? i don't have a license yet
i can do sat morning 9-12 if my mom says ok
Amazing thank you wan-ting 🙏 pls confirm when she says
I can drive the van Sunday if no one else has it. I'll pick up at 8
Perfect!! Wei-chen you're a legend 🙌
sun i'm free after 1
Great, 1pm is fine for distribution cleanup
my mom said yes!! 9 sat
Yay 🎉 see you all sat then
just finished last order sorry if i missed anything in here
Morning. Is the warehouse still the one behind the temple?
Yes same one! Back gate on the lane, front is locked
Bring gloves if u have them, spare box is empty 😅
on the bus rn be there by 9:05 sorry
No worries, we'll start with the tinned stuff
Here. Sorting the rice now
Some bags have split. Keep or toss?
Keep if the rice is dry, toss if it smells off. Put the split ones in the blue crate for the kitchen
ok
have to leave at 12 for my tutor thing, sorry. who's taking over?
Jun-jie is coming at 12 🙏 thanks for coming wan-ting!!
omw 🛵 5 min
Wei-chen, can you check the van tank for tomorrow? Last time it was low
I'll fill it on the way in tomorrow. Gas station on Xinyi opens early
just got to warehouse. yu-ting is that the whole tinned pile or more in back
More in back, two pallets. Take the left shelf first
ok my back
How did it go this morning? Sorry I missed it
Good! Got through about half the tinned stuff. Wei-chen was a machine
Not a machine. Slow and steady
done!! going home to sleep
Thanks jun-jie see u tomorrow
sorry if this is dumb but do we need to bring our own bags tomorrow or does the supermarket give crates
They give crates! Bring a cloth bag for yourself if u want
ok thanks 👍
My mother's fine, the appointment went ok. I might come by for cleanup after 1 if that's alright
Of course!! 1pm cleanup 🙌
Alarm set for 6:30
Mine's 7 lol
Up. Going to the gas station first
Morning! Supermarket loading dock is round the side not the front
Ok
At the supermarket. Found the dock
Here too, bringing the scale
14 crates of bread and some veg. Bread is from yesterday, they said it's fine
Bread's fine!! Put it at the front so it goes out first 🍞
Van is full. Heading back
Running a bit late, the bus was slow. Be there soon
At the warehouse already. Come whenever
distribution line is long already people been here since 8
Yeah the 9:30 batch is going fast. Can someone take the door list? Hand out the numbered cards
I'll do the list
Last few people in line. We'll be done by 12:30ish
van's making a noise when it brakes. wei-chen did u hear it
Yes. Brake pads maybe. I'll take it in Tuesday. Not today
Ok. Tell me when it's booked
Here now. What do you need me to do
Breaking down boxes and stacking the crates
ok im here where's the broom
Behind the door with the mop
Pads booked. Tuesday 10am, the shop on Heping Rd
how many left in the blue crate. kitchen guy is asking
Six bags. Rice mostly
ill tell him
Crates are all stacked. Anything else?
Nope you can go. Thank you!! 🙏
Anyone want the spare gloves? Otherwise I'll bring them back next week
nah keep them. i got my own 🧤
Home. Van's back in the lot
Thank you wei-chen!! ❤️
The drawings are finally done and the client already wants them redone 😩
sleep time. 6am rides tmrw
Night.
Night all 🌙
